name: Form/input test: change model picker to Travel
goal: Verify the settings picker accepts a model selection and reflects it after closing settings.
steps: Select Travel in the model picker.
Confirm the home screen reflects the selected model.
expected_result: The model picker updates the selected model to Travel, and the home screen settings label changes to Model: Travel.
success_criteria: The settings modal can be dismissed.
The home screen shows Model: Travel after dismissal.
The app does not crash while changing picker state.

ground_truth.rationale: The selected picker value updates clarifaiModelName and SettingsButton renders the nice name Travel.
